book.title: 3 JON JON PƗLƗWUTA KUVUK WAN PAS

content: TAK MBUTNDA NYAANGƗTNA
Wun njambwi nyan wun. Gaias kat wan pas pɨlɨwutɨgowun. Mɨn kat nɨmamba yelavɨka lɨgowun.
Wuna nyan, mɨn kat yelogwen mbak vɨtandɨ apma vak yetɨgiyamɨn wa wowun. Mɨna maawut apma vat tɨgandɨ. Vɨlɨgowun.
Mɨn God waa apma nyaangɨtmba wuka yetɨlɨgamɨn. mɨnagwi kɨta mbaapmamba la nɨmba wun kat yalaa apma vat yetɨma vat kat wun kat mbutndi. Wanja nyaangɨt wutaa mɨn kat nolin ngwandɨga solat sɨlɨgowun.
Mɨna wuna nyan vla lɨgamɨn. Wungi kat tɨga God wa nyaangɨtmba yiga yetɨmangat wutaa nolin ngwandɨga solat sɨlɨgowun. Nat nda ana wuna maawut kwukiyandɨ. kwutndɨ, solat sɨga nolin ngwandɨgiyowun.
GAIAS NAT NƗMBA KAT KWUNATƗGA NYANA
Wuna nyan. Jisasna mbaapma nɨmba kat kwunatɨma vat apma vatna. Jisasna mbaapmamba la nɨmba tat vɨlapman nɨmba kat kwunatɨma vat apma vatna. Apma vat yima vak kat God ngɨni awat mɨn kat kwigiyand.
Kwunapma nɨmba kumba yalaa Jisasna mbaapma nɨmba kat yima vak kat mbutndi. Ndi Godna njɨvwa kwutɨga nɨmba ndi. Ngi kat tɨga yinjeya yambɨ kwunapmeyan wovuna.
Godna njɨvwa kwupmat yindi. Godna nyangɨt mbutɨnja nɨmbananamba wenga ana klalɨndi.
Ngi kat tɨga ndi kat kwunak kiyanɨn. Ndi kat kwunatneyan wan apma nyaangɨt mbutnjeya njɨvwa kɨta vat kwutɨgiyanɨn.
DAIOTREFIS KAI WALƗGA NYANA

Mɨnai lɨga Godna yelangɨ nɨmba kat tat nat nyaangɨt pɨlɨwutwun. Ngwula kɨta nyan Daiotrefis mbukwa nyaangɨk kat kaiwandɨ. Ndi wan mbaapma nɨmbana njambwi nyanat tɨvat wandɨ. Njambwi nyan tɨwa vat ana vɨga lɨgandɨ.

Ngwuk kat yaweyan ndɨnai yilɨga kavle vak aywaa mbukiyowun. Wun kat kavle vat kwo ngambulɨgandɨ. Ndɨna kavle vat yetɨlɨnda vak wata lɨgandɨ. Jisasna mbaapma nɨmba ngwuk kat yindi maa ndi kat yagwa waa ana walɨgandɨ. Yagwa waa wagia nɨmba kat ke yagwa waa walɨgandɨ. Ndɨ kat kai waa kɨklilɨgandɨ.
DEMITRIAS APMA VAT TƗGA NYANA
Wuna nyan, ndɨ kavle vak yinda vla ke yiga. Apma vat mɨna yiga yetɨ. Apma vat yiga yetɨlɨga nyan ndɨ Godna nyana. Kavle vat yiga yetɨlɨga nyan God kat ana vɨga lɨgandɨ.
Ngwula kɨta nyan Demitrias ndɨ apma nyana. Ndi aywaa walɨgandi. Ndɨ apma nyana waa walɨgandi. Wun wuno apma nyana waa walɨgowun. Wun woseka walɨga nyan ana wun. Vɨlɨgangwuk.
NGƗNI MBUTNDA NYAANGƗTNA
Wun ngwuk kat pɨlɨwukweyan nyaangɨt nɨma sakwatno lɨgowun. Pensilmba pɨlɨwupmak kat kai wowun.
Ngwuk kat vɨlaa awat sowat ngambugiyanɨn.
Mɨn apma vat yetɨ mɨla. Wunagwinala lɨga mɨna ava nɨmba apma nandinya walɨgandi mɨn kat. Mɨnagwinala lɨga wuna ava nɨmba kat ndi kat apma nandinya awamba.
